title: weaver project
description: A project's tmux session, opened with `weave <project>`. See https://github.com/medilies/weaver#project-config

root.description: Directory the session is rooted at: absolute, or starting with ~/.

setup.description: Commands run once in root, in order, before weave <project> starts the session, e.g. docker compose up -d --wait. Each runs in its own sh -c with the project's env, not its before commands; a failing one stops the open, and no session is started. Opening a running session doesn't run them.

teardown.description: Commands run in root, in order, before weave kill ends a session weaver started, e.g. docker compose down. Each runs in its own sh -c with the project's env, not its before commands; the session is killed even when one fails.

windows.description: Windows in order. Without any, the session opens one window named after the project.

env.description: Environment variables, set literally. A window's override its project's, and a pane's its window's.

before.description: Commands typed and run in each pane before its own command, e.g. nvm use 20: the project's, then the window's, then the pane's. They are typed as soon as the pane opens, so one that reads the terminal (ssh, a password prompt) takes the lines typed after it.

clear.description: Hide the before commands once they ran: clear is typed after them, then the note printed. Set on the project, a window or a pane, the lowest winning; off unless set.

name.description: Window name, unique in the project.

dir.description: Where the window's panes start, unless they have their own dir: relative to root, absolute, or starting with ~/.

panes.description: Panes in creation order: the first fills the window, each later one splits an earlier one. With a grid, in any order and without splits. Without any, one shell in root.

name.description: Shown in the pane's top border. Required, and unique, when the window has several panes or a grid.

dir.description: Where the pane's shell starts, instead of its window's dir: relative to root (. for root itself), absolute, or starting with ~/.

command.description: Typed into the shell and run, so it stays in the shell history.

prefill.description: Typed at the prompt but not run: press Enter to run it.

note.description: Lines printed before the shell starts.

tasks.description: Commands the pane offers to run on request from weave's browser, in a session weaver started: typed into the pane when its shell is idle, otherwise, if you agree, run in a throwaway window. No two share a name, nor two unnamed ones a command.

name.description: Shown in weave's browser instead of the command.

command.description: Typed into the pane's shell and run.

grid.description: Lays the panes out by naming them in rows and columns, instead of splits: then no pane has a split, and every pane is named in the areas.

areas.description: Rows of pane names, one per column. A pane covers the rectangle of cells holding its name, and straight lines across the window must separate the panes: tmux builds no other layout.

columns.description: Column widths, one per column: percentages of the window (60%), or weights sharing out what percentages leave (2fr). Default: equal.

rows.description: Row heights, one per row: percentages of the window (70%), or weights sharing out what percentages leave (1fr). Default: equal.

split.description: How the pane is made from an earlier one. Every pane but the first has one, unless the window has a grid.

of.description: Name of the pane it splits. Default: the previous pane.

size.description: Share of the split pane: a percentage (40%) or cells (20). Default: half.
